questions.q: Do the black and white cup test in sunshine at home and explain your result.
Why does a hot cup of tea in a shiny metal mug cool more slowly than in a black matt mug? (2)
questions.a: Shiny surface emits less infrared (1) so less energy is lost by radiation (1)

questions.q: Explain why houses in hot countries are often painted white. (2)
questions.a: White is a poor absorber of radiation (1) so the house stays cooler (1)
questions.model: Property of the surface, then its effect on the house.

questions.q: Give the unit for force and for energy.
Why is a radiator's back often silvered foil on the wall side?
questions.a: Reflects infrared back into the room instead of into the wall
